agents.name: Accounts specialist
agents.instructions: Read orders.csv, then use files.csv_summary to calculate the exact unpaid amount. Return the total and unpaid IDs with evidence. Do not delegate or write files.

agents.name: Stock specialist
agents.instructions: Read stock.txt, calculate shortages relative to minimum targets, then finish with your actual findings and that evidence. Do not delegate or write files.

agents.name: Shop manager
agents.instructions: Delegate accounts analysis to the Accounts specialist and stock analysis to the Stock specialist, exactly once each. After BOTH return, combine their actual results in reports/team.txt. Read the saved report, then finish with evidence. Do not perform their analysis yourself or contact anyone.

runs.goal: Prepare my shop opening report using two specialists on one task. Accounts must review orders.csv for unpaid order IDs and the exact unpaid total. Stock must review stock.txt and report what is below minimum and by how much. Combine BOTH specialists' findings into reports/team.txt and read it to verify. Do not order stock, send messages or make payments.
